# Load & Save data
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(nirsextra)
library(plyr)
source("vitaspec_load.R")
# d0="C:/Users/guest/Documents/Martin/VitaSPEC/"
d0="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
AG=read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/Résultats VitaSpec Méso AG serie 1 (61 échantillons).csv"), sep=";", header=TRUE, dec=",")
meso=read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/V4_Vitaspec_cpx_meso_M1àM306_fm1_sd_me.csv"), sep=";", header=TRUE, dec=",")
names(meso)[names(meso) == "TE1...MF."] <- "eau"
ref = join_all(list(meso,AG), by = 'ech', type = 'full')

# Load spectra
dirs=basename(list.dirs(paste0(d0,"spectres/"), recursive = FALSE))
dirs_vita <- grep("_Vita", dirs, value = TRUE)  # Garder ceux qui contiennent "Vita"
dirs <- grep("HR", dirs_vita, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE) # Enlever ceux qui contiennent "HR"
sp=merge(vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),dirs[1]),vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),dirs[2]),by="spname",all=TRUE)
for (i in 3:(length(dirs))) {sp=merge(sp,vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),dirs[i]),by="spname",all=TRUE)}
sp= sp[-grep("Spectrum", sp$spname),]
sp$ech=sub("-.*", "", sp$spname)
sp$rep=as.numeric(substr(sp$spname,nchar(sp$spname)-4,nchar(sp$spname)))

# Set sample state
sp$etat=NA
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & !grepl("X",sp$spname)]="Meso_frais"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & grepl("X",sp$spname)]="Exo"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[,1]))]="Meso_Silica"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20250319_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]))]="Meso_Lyoph"

sp=merge(sp,ref,by="ech",all.y=TRUE)
save(sp,file="vitaspec_fruit")
```

# Cross-Val
```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rchemo))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(nirsextra))
library(data.table)
source("vitaspec_preCV.R")
source("list_pre_test.R")

condition_spectr=c("Mesocarpe Frais - 24-25","Exocarpe Frais - 24-25","Mesocarpe Silicagel - 24-25","Mesocarpe Lyoph - 24-25")
for (k in 1){#:length(condition_spectr)) {
  load("vitaspec_fruit")
  # On selectionne les bons spectres selon la condition (Meso frais, Exo, ...)
  if (k==1) {
      sp$x=sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe
      iokPobe25=which(!is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]))
      sp$x[iokPobe25,] = sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[iokPobe25,]
      sp=sp[!is.na(sp$x[,1]) & !grepl("X",sp$spname),]
  } else if (k==2) {
      cat("\n\n\\pagebreak\n")
      sp$x=sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe
      iokPobe25=which(!is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]))
      sp$x[iokPobe25,] = sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[iokPobe25,]
      sp=sp[!is.na(sp$x[,1]) & grepl("X",sp$spname),]
  } else if (k==3) { 
    cat("\n\n\\pagebreak\n")
    sp$x=sp$x20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE
    iokS25=which(!is.na(sp$x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[,1]))
    sp$x[iokS25,] = sp$x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[iokS25,]
    sp=sp[!is.na(sp$x[,1]),]
  } else if (k==4) {
    cat("\n\n\\pagebreak\n")
    sp$x=sp$x20250319_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE
    iokL25=which(!is.na(sp$x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]))
    sp$x[iokL25,] = sp$x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[iokL25,]
    sp=sp[!is.na(sp$x[,1]),]
  }
  cat(paste0("\\begin{center}\n\\fontsize{24}{16}\\selectfont\\underline{", condition_spectr[k], "}\n\\end{center}\n\\normalsize\n\\par\n"))

  ag=colnames(sp)[43]#[c(33,43:50)] 
  options(warn=-1)
  
  for (i in 1:length(ag)) {
    ag1=ag[i]
    # print(ag1)
    
    # En moyennant les rép
    dat=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
    dat$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
    dat$ech=dat$Group.1; dat=dat[,-1]
    iout=which(is.na(dat[,colnames(dat)==ag1]))
    if (length(iout)>0) {datok=dat[-iout,]} else datok=dat
    if (nrow(datok)<100) {rdmsp=1:nrow(datok)} else {rdmsp=sample.int(nrow(datok),100)}
    plotsp(datok$x[rdmsp,])
    title(condition_spectr[k])

    vitaspec_preCV(datok$x,datok[,colnames(datok)==ag1],list_pre,15, titl=condition_spectr[k]) 
  }
}
```

# Comparaison des spectres selon conditions
```{r}
load("vitaspec_fruit")

# Set sample state !!! A supprier qd ce sera inclut dans vitaspec_fruit
sp$etat=NA
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & !grepl("X",sp$spname)]="Meso_frais"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & grepl("X",sp$spname)]="Exo"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[,1]))]="Meso_Silica"
sp$etat[(!is.na(sp$x20250319_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(sp$x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]))]="Meso_Lyoph"

condition_spectr=c("Mesocarpe Frais - 24-25","Exocarpe Frais - 24-25","Mesocarpe Silicagel - 24-25","Mesocarpe Lyoph - 24-25")
cols_x <- grep("^x", names(sp), value = TRUE)
mat_concat <- do.call(rbind, sp[cols_x])
etat=rep(sp$etat,10)
spcmp=mat_concat[!is.na(mat_concat[,1]),]
etat=etat[!is.na(mat_concat[,1])]
# colnames(spcmp)=colnames(sp$x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe)
spcmpm=aggregate(spcmp, list(etat), mean)
etatm=spcmpm$Group.1
spcmpm=as.matrix(spcmpm[,-1])

col <- hcl.colors(n = nrow(spcmpm))
plotsp(spcmpm,col=col)
legend(x="topright",legend=etatm, col = col,lty=1)

```

# Calibration with dryed mesocarp - Compare AGAP and DIADE spectrometer
```{r eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
d="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
sp=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"spectres/20240405_VitaSPEC_S_AGAP/")))
sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
ref=read.table(paste0(d,"analyses_ref/Données_pour_NIRS_TEmeso.csv"), sep=";",header=TRUE, dec = ",")
ref$ech=paste0(ref$Identifiant,"-",ref$Code.arbre)
colnames(ref)[colnames(ref) == "TE1...MF."] = "Eau"
sp=merge(sp, ref,by="ech")
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]
vitaspec_preCV(spm$x,spm$Eau,list_pre,10, titl="Teneur en eau. Pts de mesures moy. par fruit. Meso séché - AGAP") 

sp=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"spectres/20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE/")))
sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
sp=merge(sp, ref,by="ech")
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]
vitaspec_preCV(spm$x,spm$Eau,list_pre,10, titl="Teneur en eau. Pts de mesures moy. par fruit.  Meso séché - DIADE") 
```

# Explore 2 years on fresh fruits
```{r eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# d="C:/Users/guest/Documents/Martin/VitaSPEC/"
d="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
sp24=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"spectres/20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe/")))
sp24$annee=24
sp25=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"spectres/20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe/")))
sp25$annee=25
sp=rbind(sp24,sp25)
# Excude exocarp spectra
sp=sp[!grepl("FX",rownames(sp)),]

sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
# Average spectra
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]

p=rbind(list('adj',''),list('snv',''))
spm$xp=pre(spm$x,p)
loess_fit <- apply(spm$xp, 1, function(s) loess(s ~ as.integer(colnames(spm$xp)), span = 0.05))
spm$xp2 <- I(t(sapply(loess_fit, function(t) t$fitted)))

col=rep("red",nrow(spm))
col[spm$annee==24]="black"
plotsp(spm$x,col=col)

fm <- pca(spm$xp2, ncomp = 10)
plotxy(fm$Tr[, c(1,2)], group = spm$annee)
```
